# Synthetic failure capture after the chunked AI public-claim extraction request

Source commit 606efdf2d526c9fd53e66c2fb7e87d0d102a4505 (buildMemoAiExtractionMessages sends its state through observationContextMessages, like the other memo-bearing requests: unchanged up to 20,000 characters, numbered chunks beyond; on top of plan O, opt-in two_stage_v2 and the research Jev cap). Two independent captures were made on a clean tree with the generator (`node tests/support/generate-failure-fixture.ts <dir>`); they differ from each other only at 15 run-ID leaves.

Compared with the adopted failure-path-repair-facts-e6e2c67 capture, records differ only at 41 leaves: 15 run IDs, 25 instruction-source hash leaves (`decision/jev-decision.ts`, `local-grounding/extract-ai.ts`, `local-grounding/jev-local-test.ts`, `v2/dialogue-v2.mjs` and `v2/jev-turn.ts` in each of the 5 scenarios) and the derived `identity.prompts` digest. Compared with the intermediate failure-path-two-stage-v2-3c8b71f capture, only the 15 run IDs, the 5 `local-grounding/extract-ai.ts` hash leaves and `identity.prompts` differ. In the metadata only `baseCommit`, `fixtureSha256` and source hashes change (72 source files, all checked against the commit's files). The scenarios' extraction states are short, so every request payload, behavior, schema, failure, clock, policy, call/send and storage is unchanged. Existing 3 run-ID exclusions are unchanged.

It replaces the intermediate failure-path-two-stage-v2-3c8b71f capture, which was never adopted outside this branch. Earlier adopted fixture directories remain byte-identical. Only the current provenance target URL and its baseCommit literal move. No real API, Keychain, .env, study data or live run was used.
